messages.subject: visualizing / printing list based data
parts:
Hi,

I have a list with several list in it. E.g.

list( list( user="markus", age=33, id=c(12321,32324)), list( user="perter", age=45, id=c(22)), list(app="demo", id=c(43423)))

This is a data object imported from a NoSQL database. In my Shiny App I created some statistics and graphs using this data. Now I would like to view the original data. But I can not create a table from that:
as.table(test)
Error in as.table.default(test) : cannot coerce to a table

renderText can not deal with lists:
Error in cat(list(...), file, sep, fill, labels, append) :
  argument 1 (type 'list') cannot be handled by 'cat'

renderPrint creates a horrible output:
[1] "[[1]] [[1]]$user [1] \"markus\" [[1]]$age [1] 33 [[1]]$id [1] 12321 32324 [[2]] [[2]]$user [1] \"perter\" [[2]]$age [1] 45 [[2]]$id [1] 22 [[3]] [[3]]$app [1] \"demo\" [[3]]$id [1] 43423 "

Any ideas or solutions?

Thanks a lot.
